# kayjs-ui

> Components for kay apps, shipped as `.kay` sources the app compiles as its own and styled by the classes of one `theme.css` the app restyles: buttons, forms and inputs, dialogs, tables, navigation, layouts, charts, drag and drop, media and more.

## Topics

The rest by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, settings and testing](llms/setup.md): installing the theme and components, the settings that map icons, testing an app that uses it
- [Icons, buttons, toasts, dialogs, cards, popovers and stats](llms/basics.md): Icon, Button, toast, Dialog, ConfirmDelete, Card, Badge, Notice, Avatar, Popover, TooltipHost, Stat, Meter, BarList, CopyButton, Rating
- [Inputs, selects, editors and forms](llms/forms.md): TextInput, Textarea, Select, RangeInput, MultiSelect, Combobox, FileDrop, Menu, IconPicker, MarkdownEditor, Steps, and forms with FormDialog
- [Tables, tabs, pagination, page layout, command palette and trees](llms/tables-navigation-and-layout.md): Table, Segmented, Tabs, TabNav, SiteNav, AppHeader, Toggle, Checkbox, Pagination, QrCode, PageHeader, SidePanel, SplitLayout, CommandPalette, TreeView
- [Texts and languages](llms/words.md): the `ui.*` messages that word every default text, and the page's locale in charts
- [Charts, drag and drop, galleries and image tools](llms/charts-drag-and-media.md): LineChart, ScatterChart, ContributionGraph, Sortable, Board, DropTargets, MediaGallery, Carousel, Masonry, WhenVisible, LoadMore, VirtualList, ZoomPane, ImageCropper
